Emz Emma  recommends Trim Dog Pet Centre.

Friendly and very welcoming team of staff. Always happy to help and assist customers to find what they are looking for, nothing is ever too much trouble
.
Would highly recommend Trim Dog for any animal needs, if they havent got what you need in stock they will try to order in what you require or suggest alternatives I.e animal foods which is brilliant as other places don't.
Five star service all the time!

items.author: Carol Ozanne
items.headline: Carol Ozanne recommends Trim Dog Pet Centre.

items.text: Excellent service from the team at trim dog, phoned the other day to order some food for my dog, lady over the phone really helpful and took payment and nick delivered the food right outside our door a couple of hours later.  Fab service as always
items.author: Ashley Le Poidevin
items.headline: Ashley Le Poidevin recommends Trim Dog Pet Centre.

items.text:
Trim Dog is an amazing example of a local company who offer fantastic service. Our guinea pig Tigger broke her leg, had to be separated from her friend Truffle and after weeks of treatment ended up having her leg amputated needing a long recovery time. Trim Dog let us borrow a cage for Tigger to live in for 5 months and didn’t ask for a penny in return. We were so grateful and will definitely be using them for our guinea pig and dog  products in the future. Thank you! See less

Trim Dog Pet Centre is an awesome store run by a the legend that is Jan and an amazing team it has all you’ll ever need and they are happy to go above and beyond to ensure both you and your pets are content and cared for in every way! I am the very proud feather mummy to 4 beautiful and entirely pampered birds that have settled into their forever homes with ease thanks to the teams expert care on arrival into the island and I have never seen a sad pet or owner in there ever ..... would recommend Trim Dog in a heartbeat
 See less

very friendly staff. great advice.

Always kind helpful warm friendly. Beautiful Guinea pigs. Miss them very much now not got car. Marilyn

Can not recommend this Pet centre enough, I live on Herm Island and struggle to get to Trim dog pet centre in between boat times and weather etc.
They hand delivered items to the Herm boat for me as well as taking the time to pick the items out themselves.
My lovebirds and I can not thank you enough.
Coconut & Mango are definitely enjoying their sunflower seeds and new toys.

Lovely place lovely people, very helpful

items.text: Excellent service. We are having to isolate for 12weeks, so unable to get out. I called Trim Dog with our order and this was delivered within 1/2 hour. Thank you so much.

Finley is still missing.
Finley is still missing, We had a positive sighting of him a couple of weeks ago near the area of the vets but nothing since, having put food down for him. Thank you to the lady who got in touch.
Any news would be great even if knowing he is still alive and living the life! He is quite small so someone may think he is a kitten but he is nearly 3.
Fin escaped during a very stressful visit to Les Eturs vets on 14th April. He ran towards Talbot Valley but could have gone anywhere. We live in St Martin’s so a long way to find his way home. He's quite small and spends a lot of time outside so don't think he would enter a strange house.
We are offering a reward for his return or positive news of him.
Please let us know if you see him. He is also microchipped if he ends up at a vets anywhere. I know the RSPCA will check but the vets don't always when brought in for any checks or treatment.
